findings.evidence: Lines 183–196 contain no `self_mem_aux`, `⁻¹`, or `inv_mul_cancel₀`; the only field-specific step is `mul_right_cancel₀` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/GroupWithZero/Defs.lean:81, needs `IsRightCancelMulZero`). `class IsDomain ... extends IsCancelMulZero α` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Defs.lean:438). `theorem eigenvectors_linearIndependent' {ι : Type*} [IsDomain R] ...` under `[CommRing R]` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Eigenspace/Basic.lean:65,745). Sole in-repo use is over a field (TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/Weight.lean:217), so the generalization is compatible.
findings.fix: Move it out of `section Field` into its own section with `variable [CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] {f : V →ₗ[K] V} {a : ι → K}` (proof unchanged; `IsDomain` extends `IsCancelMulZero`, which `mul_right_cancel₀` needs). findings.issue: `Module.Basis.exists_apply_eq_and_mem_span_singleton` is stated under `[Field K]` but never uses `self_mem_aux` or inverses; its proof uses only `repr_apply_of_apply_basis` (CommSemiring), `mul_right_cancel₀` (IsRightCancelMulZero), `Finsupp.ne_iff`, `map_eq_zero_iff`, and `eq_smul_of_support_subset_singleton` (Semiring). Mathlib states the neighbouring fact `Module.End.eigenvectors_linearIndependent'` over `[CommRing R] [IsDomain R]`, so `Field` is stronger than convention here.

summary: The three private helpers now sit at the hypotheses their proofs use (Semiring/AddCommMonoid for the singleton-support lemma, CommRing for coordinate clearing; Field is genuinely needed by `self_mem_aux` via `c⁻¹`). But the PR description's claim that every public theorem needs `[Field K]` because of `self_mem_aux` is false for `exists_apply_eq_and_mem_span_singleton`, which only cancels a nonzero scalar and so belongs at Mathlib's domain level.
